objective: Additional mirrored win-rate improvement of at least 5 percentage points over the immediately preceding candidate, not a cumulative improvement over R4.
fixedBidding: Frozen baseline Hard for all seats
gameFlow: Frozen baseline runHeadlessRound, default start seat 0 and base score 1
pairing: Each seed and target seat plays candidate target against baseline fillers, then baseline target against candidate fillers; 6 games per seed.

holdoutAfterQualityFix.status: preregistered before execution; only after fresh source freeze and regression repair

selection: Screen and development overlap and are exploratory. Keep all rejected results. Confirmation may inform candidate selection; holdout must remain unused until candidate source is frozen. Candidate1 later failed existing Hard-vs-Normal quality regression; its completed holdout must be archived, never reused as independent acceptance after source changes. Candidate2 uses the separately preregistered dataset.

acceptance.strongerClaim: A confidence lower bound of at least 5pp is reported separately; a 5pp point estimate with a positive lower bound does not establish that stronger claim.

integrity: Source hashes, frozen baseline hashes, arena hash, seed list, complete shards, game identities, role coverage and fixed landlord identity are checked before judging.
latency: Frozen repository corpus; decision p95 <60ms and max <250ms, hint max <400ms. Server results are not mobile measurements.
limitations: Role intervals are exploratory and are not adjusted for multiple comparisons.
Farmer mirror changes both partner and landlord; it does not isolate a single agent's causal improvement.
Development gains cannot substitute for independent holdout evidence.
Existing Cocos hint runtime capture failures require a new Creator build and genuine click capture before release.
